summary: An excerpt from Book 4 (part 76) of a science-fiction narrative. Benny, a robot, carries Arturo and Ada through a countryside swarming with headless, eight-armed black robots built by Social Harmony. Lenny is overwhelmed and Natalie is killed, and Arturo and Ada weep. Later the group lands in Beijing, where they are astonished to find Natalie alive, though Benny says she died in UNATS, killed by modified Eurasian Social Harmony robots.
one_line: In a robot-filled futuristic chase, Benny rescues Arturo and Ada, Natalie and Lenny are killed, and Natalie reappears alive in Beijing.
key_facts: Social Harmony had secretly built an army of headless, eight-armed black robots and dispersed them across the land.
The black robots were described as arachnoid and sinister in the moonlight.
Benny beat back tentacles and smashed black robots with mighty one-handed blows while supporting Arturo and Ada.
Lenny was the vanguard, encountering twice as many robots as the others.
A black spider-robot clung to Lenny's leg while another robot tugged at Natalie.
One black robot tossed Natalie into the arms of another, which skewered her on a black spear through her belly.
Lenny was overwhelmed a moment later, buried under writhing black arms.
Benny said, "They're dead. There's nothing to go back for."
Ada wept on the jet, and Arturo wept with her.
The group changed jets again for the long trip to Beijing, where they slept during the flight.
Beijing was described as having curvilinear towers that twisted and bent so high they disappeared at the tops.
Beijing smelled like barbeque and flowers, and was filled with fast armies of robots wheeling in lockstep.
In Beijing, Natalie, whom Arturo calls Natty, appeared alive behind them with tears in her eyes and kissed Arturo and Ada on the cheeks.
Benny told them, "You died in UNATS. Killed by modified Eurasian Social Harmony robots. Lenny, too. Ironic."
